{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── TeamNotes.txt          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

```

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**

```

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.

documents/

```

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file

```

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

```markdown
# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.

3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |

| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |

| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.

documents/

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── TeamNotes.txt          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- Use Markdown tables for quick scanning.  
- Add emojis to make the status stand out.  
- Link to prototypes (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- Archive old ideas after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── TeamNotes.txt          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- Use Markdown tables for quick scanning.  
- Add emojis to make the status stand out.  
- Link to prototypes (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- Archive old ideas after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

```
documents/

```

- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

documents/

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.

4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |

  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**

```

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.

4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |

| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

```markdown

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**

```

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

documents/

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

### Tips

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file

│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template

```

---

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file

│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template

    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

```
documents/

- Add emojis to make the status stand out.

- Archive old ideas after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

# Fresh Ideas Tracker

> **Purpose** – A single place to capture, review, and prioritize new ideas before they move into the development pipeline.

---

## 📌 Quick Start

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.  
2. **Tag & Prioritize** – Add tags (e.g., `UX`, `Feature`, `BugFix`) and set a priority level (1–5).  
3. **Review** – Weekly or bi‑weekly, the team reviews the list, votes, and moves the highest‑priority items to the backlog.  
4. **Track** – Once an idea is accepted, create a ticket in the ticketing system and link it here.

---

## 📋 Idea Template

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Short, descriptive name. |
| **Description** | Detailed explanation, context, and potential impact. |
| **Source** | Who suggested it? (e.g., *John Doe*, *Customer Feedback*). |
| **Date Added** | Auto‑generated or manually entered. |
| **Tags** | Keywords for filtering (e.g., `UI`, `Performance`). |
| **Priority** | 1 (Low) – 5 (High). |
| **Status** | `New`, `Under Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`, `Done`. |
| **Link** | URL to related ticket or prototype. |

---

## 📅 Example Entry

```markdown
### 1. Dark Mode Toggle for Mobile App
- **Description:**  
  Users have requested a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during nighttime usage.  
  This would involve adding a toggle in the settings and applying a dark theme across all screens.

- **Source:**  
  *Jane Smith – Product Manager*

- **Date Added:**  
  2026‑07‑09

- **Tags:**  
  UI, Accessibility, Feature

- **Priority:**  
  4

- **Status:**  
  Under Review

- **Link:**  
  [Ticket #1234](https://ticketing.company.com/ticket/1234)
```

---

## 🔄 Workflow

1. **Capture** – Anyone can add an idea.  
2. **Review** – Product & Engineering review weekly.  
3. **Approve** – Move to backlog or create a ticket.  
4. **Implement** – Track progress in the ticketing system.  
5. **Close** – Once done, mark as `Done` and archive.

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```
documents/
├── FreshIdeas.md          ← This file
├── IdeaTemplates/
│   └── IdeaTemplate.md    ← Optional reusable template
└── Backlog/
    └── 2026-07-09-ideas.xlsx  ← Exported list for planning
```

---

- **Use Markdown tables** for quick scanning.  
- **Add emojis** to make the status stand out.  
- **Link to prototypes** (Figma, InVision) directly in the entry.  
- **Archive old ideas** after a year to keep the list lean.

---

Happy ideating! 🚀

1. **Add a new idea** – Use the “New Idea” button or simply append a new entry below.

| Field | Description |
